    Roiter's transit lemma #

    This file records the exact algebraic output of BGRS Section 1.5. For a composable pair f : X ⟶ Y, g : Y ⟶ Z with f prohibiting cotransit and g prohibiting transit, Roiter's lemma says that one side kills the square of the middle Jacobson radical. Its stated consequence is that the space of middle-endomorphism sandwiches has dimension at most one.

    The class below isolates that source theorem while its mildness/cleaving proof is constructed. The remaining results in this file are unconditional linear algebra consequences of its two literal conclusions.
